end.parentNote: Myra practised copying shapes on dot and square grids by counting the gaps between dots. They connected a square to their house drawing and correctly described a rectangle as having two short and two long sides. They initially counted dots instead of gaps, but corrected this later by using five dots to find four gaps (correctAfterLastSeen). At home, draw a short line of five dots and ask Myra to count the gaps before measuring another side.
